# The Thumb-2 forms whose vectors differ from the lift today, one a line: the kind and the
# template as templates.txt writes them, then after `:` why. The arm32 test of
# crates/ra-asm-lift/tests/vectors/arm32.rs passes when exactly these forms differ: an unlisted
# form that differs fails it with a line to paste here, and a listed form that passes fails it
# with "remove from PENDING.txt", so the card that fixes an arm removes its line. A form of the
# ARM groups has `arm` after its kind: the same lift reads ARM code, and its vectors replay too.
StoreExclusive strex {Rd}, {Rm}, [{Rb}]: alone, with no ldrex before it, the machine's store fails; the lift's always wins
Unsupported ldrexb {Rt}, [{Rb}]: the lift lacks the form and traps
Call blx #{label20}: a call into ARM code, which the lift traps on
